disambiguation: Not a standard Excalidraw board, it functions as a dedicated, always-on-top reference popout.
extras: Desktop-only plugin; currently untested on Mac or Linux systems.
intentEvidence: Excalidraw PureRef is a desktop-only Obsidian plugin for using an Excalidraw Board as a PureRef-style reference surface.
problem: Standard Excalidraw boards lack the functionality of a dedicated reference surface, and drawing on embedded media is not supported.

relations.evidence: using an Excalidraw Board as a PureRef-style reference surface.
Requires the compatible Excalidraw renderer build.

summary: Excalidraw PureRef converts an Excalidraw board into an always-on-top, reference-style popout window with advanced image manipulation and organization features.
